main.description: Every version of a record this knot hosts, oldest first unless order says otherwise. A version's bytes are fetched by content id through com.atproto.sync.getBlocks.

uri.description: Record in a repo this knot hosts

order.description: asc lists the oldest version first, desc the newest.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page, left out when the page already reaches the newest version

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The uri isn't an at-uri, or the collection isn't versioned

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such record on this knot

errors.name: ProjectionWarming
errors.description: The record's change history is still being folded; retry shortly

changeId.description: Object ID of the git change that produced this version

editor.description: The account that authored the change

createdAt.description: When this knot wrote the commit this version rides in. Not the record's own `createdAt`.

cid.description: Content id of this version. Missing when the version was removed or the change is a deletion.
